title: Emps
summary_html: Emps are a sapient race of diminutive simian creatures, reclusively living in a village among the silverleaf trees of the Deep Forest. They appear in Ultima VII. Their name derives from the belief that they have empathic traits, as demonstrated by their intense respect for a variety of living organisms. Their end may have come due to the Imbalance that occurred in Ultima VII Part Two.
